task_title: Land commit-bound GitReins verdicts for the four landed-but-unjudged rows (AUG-127, AUG-123, AUG-135, AUG-120)
task_criteria: PROOF: python3 scripts/audit_board_evidence.py --verbose | grep -cE '^BOUND AUG-(120|123|127|135) .*\(pass\)' prints 4. FAILIF: any count other than 4 — one of the four rows this task names is unbound, or is bound to a verdict that is not a pass.

PROOF: jq -r 'select(.id=="AUG-120" or .id=="AUG-123" or .id=="AUG-127" or .id=="AUG-135") | .id + " " + .status + " " + .evidence_run_id' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl prints four lines reading AUG-120 complete 6ea40f07, AUG-123 complete e3421934, AUG-127 complete da694ece, AUG-135 complete 95ad7929, and each named run directory exists under .gitreins/history with a verdict.json whose task_id equals the row id. FAILIF: a row that is not complete, a missing run id, a run id that does not resolve to a verdict.json, or a verdict.json whose task_id differs from the row id — that is the fabricated-id failure this row exists to forbid.

PROOF: python3 scripts/audit_board_evidence.py exits 0 and prints RESULT: OK with unresolvable=0 and missing=0. FAILIF: a non-zero exit, RESULT: FAIL, or any unresolvable/missing count above zero across the whole tracked board.

PROOF: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_board_evidence_audit.py prints 17 passed. FAILIF: any failure, error, or a pass count other than 17 — the audit contract that binds board rows to verdict artifacts would no longer be pinned by tests.

PROOF: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_board_evidence_audit.py -k "dangling_run_id or another_task or fabricated_label" prints 4 passed, proving the audit REFUSES a dangling run id, a verdict for another task, and a fabricated label. FAILIF: any failure or a pass count other than 4 — "no fabricated ids" would then be an assertion rather than an enforced rule.
